title: Yoisaki Kanade — I'm Here, My Friend〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Something may've happened to her phone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're able to see what's going on over in your world by using the functionality of your phones.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, does this mean her phone's broken?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
B-But, I mean... Now?
That seems like way too big a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I agree that Mafuyu and I will need to have a little heart to heart...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which should give her an opportunity to see that she doesn't need your silly, little group and that becoming a doctor is what's best for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be back to normal after we've had a chance to talk things over...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (As much as I don't want to think about it, what if her mom did do something...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(If she really did...
That means I should've been more careful.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I think I'd convinced myself that she wouldn't do anything to Mafuyu's phone even under the worst circumstances...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Ena said she just got to Miya Girls!
But Mafuyu apparently left already...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
Oh... I'm at the CD shop right now, but no sign of her here either...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Same with the station...
I'm about to go check out the diner where we usually have our after-parties!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sounds good. Then, I'll try looking for her at the mall...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I will. Talk to you later.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I finally made it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(My legs feel so heavy...
I thought I'd been exercising more than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But I don't have time to rest...
I need to keep looking for Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I have some good news for you.
Miku and KAITO were able to reach Mafuyu's phone.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Where is she?
No, more importantly, did you find out what happened?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
And her phone fell into her aquarium...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I didn't think she'd resort to that, but she actually tried to take Mafuyu's phone away...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So, how about Mafuyu...?
She said she was going to tell her mom how she really feels...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, she was apparently on her way home to do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Don't worry. Well, I'm not really in a position to be saying that... But Miku and KAITO are there with her.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'm sure Mafuyu will appreciate having them there with her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Now that we've found her, why don't you head home for now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
Oh, I should let Mizuki and Ena know...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<We've got that covered.
MEIKO said she'd go tell them what happened.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I suppose there isn't much point in lingering here any longer. I should follow Luka's advice and head home for...)

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: Hey, it got really dark and cloudy all of a sudden. Do you think it's gonna rain...?

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: Wait, I didn't bring an umbrella...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, they're right...
It did suddenly get very dark.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You should get home before it starts coming down.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Luka, thank you for letting me know how Mafuyu's doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Of course.
Anyway, I'll let you know if I hear any further news.>
